enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Fall asleep. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up. Stand up and walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Remove clothes and step into shower. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Wet body and apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower and step out. Dry body with towel. Wash face at sink. Rinse and dry face. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cabinet. Take out tea bag and cup. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Remove toast. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Put on clothes. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Insert laptop and notebook. Insert pen. Close work bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Attend meeting. Take notes. Review program documents. Edit program plan. Print documents. File documents. Attend another meeting. Update database. Send follow-up emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to restaurant. Enter restaurant. Look at menu. Order food. Pay for food. Wait for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Leave restaurant. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting partner organizations and planning upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Attend meeting with partners. Discuss event details. Take notes. Use computer to update event plan. Call partner organization. Send emails to partners. Review budget. Print event flyers. Meet with colleague. Brainstorm event ideas. Create timeline. Assign tasks. Follow up with partners. Attend another meeting. Update event calendar.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment building. Walk to door. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat and vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Remove clothes and step into shower. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Wet body and apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower and step out. Dry body with towel. Wash face at sink. Rinse and dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing program notes and browsing the phone with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open notebook. Read program notes. Write notes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Reply to messages. Put down phone. Read more notes. Highlight important points. Write summary. Pick up phone again. Check email. Put down phone. Close notebook. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed.

Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
